name: NEXT_{dist}_m_WHITE_WIDE
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the white edge and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. R6-SA106A (1200 x 370) illustrated (B 1440 x 450, C 1800 x 560), 2015, 1:10; R50, 10 / 30 (edge 10 + border 20). One line: NEXT 140 C (ink 356), 105 gap, distance numerals 140 C ('Varies', dashed box), 70 gap, m 120 C lower case (ink 101); baseline 255 (top 115, 115 below). The sheet's chain 149 / 356 / 105 / varies / 70 / 101 / 149 fixes the margins for its dashed box (270 wide); the numerals are centred in that 270 slot (610-880). The sheet gives no example distance: generated at 100 to 900 m in hundreds (a sign under R6-22 for lengths short of 1 km; R6-SA105 covers whole km) — not confirmed against SA practice. Mounted below R6-22.
